target_customer: Restaurants and restaurant groups, starting in Sweden
problem: Restaurants miss a large share of calls and reply slowly to email, losing bookings. Elyra answers calls and emails with AI and optimizes table allocation.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for restaurants (pricing not public)
product_category: AI reservation and guest communication system for restaurants

founders.name: Felix Odeberg Glasenapp
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; KTH Innovation page also lists him as founder.

founders.name: Alan Mando
founders.background_notes: The two met in primary school in Stockholm.

competitors.name: Slang.ai
competitors.what: Voice AI answering restaurant reservation calls and writing bookings into OpenTable and SevenRooms

competitors.name: Loman AI
competitors.what: Voice AI phone agent integrated with OpenTable

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and email agents plus table allocation optimization and reservation system integration need real engineering, but components such as voice models are available.

defensibility.rationale: Owning the reservation system and guest data raises switching costs, but voice reservation agents are widely available.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; reservation platforms and voice vendors already offered AI answering in 2026.

market_need_then: The company claims restaurants miss 40% of calls and lose $100K a year; figures are self-reported. A Swedish feature says the founders found the idea when nobody answered at a restaurant.

branding.domain_note: Uses elyrasystems.com; the shorter elyra name is used by other products including a Carl Zeiss microscope mark
branding.community_and_virality: A Swedish business feature profiled the founders, but it is not about the brand itself

brand_strength.rationale: Some local press on the founders and named restaurant group logos on the site, but no independent brand evidence and the name is shared with other products.

outcome_analysis: Elyra is an active Spring 2026 company with no outcome yet. Childhood friends with engineering and business training built a restaurant AI system and report restaurant group customers in Stockholm. Voice reservation competitors already existed, so differentiation through table allocation and email handling is the open question.
notes: Aggregators (PitchBook, FundedIQ, VCBacked) report a $500K pre-seed but disagree on date (March vs June 2026) and investors (YC and KTH Innovation vs KTH Holding and SSE Ventures); no primary source, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Founding year conflicts across sources (2023 vs 2025), so left null. Location conflicts between Stockholm and San Francisco. Customer logos are from the company site.
